settings.weig.unit.secondShort.reason: The SI seconds unit s stays unchanged in Italian compact time displays.
settings.weig.unit.secondShort.evidence: Canonical English is s, the international SI seconds symbol.

settings.size.standard.reason: Standard is the established Italian software setting term for the default text size.
settings.size.standard.evidence: Canonical English settings.size.standard is the single-word size option Standard; Italian normally writes Standard identically.

settings.density.standard.reason: Standard is a natural, unchanged Italian preset adjective for standard UI density.
settings.density.standard.evidence: English canonical is the preset label Standard, also used verbatim in Italian UI choices.

settings.weig.option.standard.reason: Italian uses Standard as a standard, short UI preset choice; a synonym would alter the level implied.
settings.weig.option.standard.evidence: Canonical English is precisely Standard, used as an unchanged Italian software loanword.

common.na.reason: N/A is the neutral technical indicator for an unknown unavailable/inapplicable field; no more specific cause is given.
